story_hook: A street child of the outer provinces, you have nothing to your name but a stubborn will to rise.
description: The baseline path: no birthright, no backing, only what you carve out for yourself.

story_hook: Born to a fading house, you carry a name that once commanded armies — and the debts to match.
description: Wealth, a famous name, and the Star Dao — but your house watches your every step.

story_hook: Left at the sect gates as an infant, you were raised in the shadow of the mountain hall.
description: A sect upbringing sharpens your comprehension and steadies your foundation.

story_hook: Once you stood among the deathless. Now, cast down and mortal, you begin again.
description: Fragments of a deathless past linger: a sharper blade, a deeper well, and the Time Dao.
